title: Additivity of polynomial evaluation
statement: Let $c$ and $d$ be coefficient families indexed by subsets of $\\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. Evaluating the coefficientwise sum $c+d$ at $x$ gives the sum of their evaluations: $\operatorname{ANF}(c+d)(x)=\operatorname{ANF}(c)(x)+\operatorname{ANF}(d)(x)$.
